metadata.question: Is the size of ozone hole (<220 Dobson units) over Antarctica between September 26 and 30, 2024 larger than that between August 26 and 30, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_O3 (Sentinel-5P Ozone) - Date ranges: Aug 26-30, 2024 and Sep 26-30, 2024 - Location: Antarctica region (use large bounding box or entire Antarctic continent) - Band: 'O3_column_number_density' (in mol/m²) 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask based on quality flags (qa_value) - Ozone hole definition: <220 Dobson Units (DU) - Need to convert mol/m² to Dobson Units: 1 DU = 2.69e-5 mol/m² - So 220 DU = 220 * 2.69e-5 = 0.005918 mol/m² - Mask to only include pixels where ozone < 220 DU 3. Logic: - Calculate area of ozone hole (pixels with O3 < 220 DU) for both periods - Compare the two areas - Valid zero would mean no ozone hole detected (unlikely but possible) - Null/Error (C3) would be if calculation fails or returns invalid values - C1 if no images found - C2 if images exist but all pixels masked out ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const antarctica = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[[-180, -60], [180, -60], [180, -90], [-180, -90], [-180, -60]]], null, false ); const august_start = '2024-08-26'; const august_end = '2024-08-30'; const september_start = '2024-09-26'; const september_end = '2024-09-30'; // Ozone hole threshold: 220 DU = 0.005918 mol/m² const ozone_threshold = 220 * 2.69e-5; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const col_aug = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_O3') .filterDate(august_start, august_end) .filterBounds(antarctica) .select('O3_column_number_density'); const col_sep = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_O3') .filterDate(september_start, september_end) .filterBounds(antarctica) .select('O3_column_number_density'); const aug_size = await col_aug.size().getInfo(); const sep_size = await col_sep.size().getInfo(); console.log(`August images: ${aug_size}`); console.log(`September images: ${sep_size}`); if (aug_size === 0 || sep_size === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create mean composites and identify ozone hole const aug_mean = col_aug.mean(); const sep_mean = col_sep.mean(); // Create mask for ozone hole (values < 220 DU) const aug_hole = aug_mean.lt(ozone_threshold); const sep_hole = sep_mean.lt(ozone_threshold); // 4. Calculate pixel counts for ozone hole area const aug_count = await aug_hole.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: antarctica, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('O3_column_number_density').getInfo(); const sep_count = await sep_hole.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: antarctica, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('O3_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`August ozone hole pixels: ${aug_count}`); console.log(`September ozone hole pixels: ${sep_count}`); // Check for valid calculation if (aug_count === null || sep_count === null || isNaN(aug_count) || isNaN(sep_count)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Check for no valid pixels if (aug_count === 0 && sep_count === 0) { console.log("No ozone hole pixels detected in either period."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Compare sizes and provide answer console.log(`September hole is larger: ${sep_count > aug_count}`); if (sep_count > aug_count) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
